item.text: {"protocol_version":"wp5-v3","responses":[{"task_id":"ambiguous-06-offline-mode","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"What offline capability do you want in the first version: read previously opened documents only, or also create/edit changes while offline?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Make the editor usable offline for the first version.","T":"Enable offline access to previously opened documents from the client read cache without adding offline editing.","S":"Cover client behavior for opening and reading documents that were opened before losing network access. Exclude document edits, mutation queuing, sync, and conflict resolution.","V":"Verify that a previously opened document can be reopened and read with the network unavailable, that uncached documents remain unavailable offline with a clear message, and that normal server-authoritative behavior resumes when online.","X":"Stop if the existing read cache cannot reliably persist previously opened documents across offline sessions or if the change requires defining offline write/conflict behavior.","P":"Persist through drafting the smallest bounded slice: offline read-only access for cached documents only.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-03-csv-import-mapping","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"When the CSV has invalid rows, should the import block entirely, skip invalid rows, or let the user review and choose before saving?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Let users import contacts from CSV.","T":"Add a CSV import flow with preview, validation, field mapping for required contact data, duplicate detection for email addresses, and explicit confirmation before any save.","S":"Include upload, basic CSV parsing, mapping to contact fields, validation that each contact has name and one reachable address, marking duplicate email rows as invalid, previewing valid and invalid rows, and allowing users to skip invalid rows before confirming import. Exclude partial save before confirmation and any new duplicate-merging behavior.","V":"Verify that users can upload a CSV, map columns, see invalid and duplicate-email rows in preview, exclude those rows, and save only confirmed valid rows after approval; verify nothing is saved before confirmation.","X":"Stop if importing contacts requires a new contact schema beyond current required fields or if duplicate handling must do more than reject duplicate emails.","P":"Persist with the smallest verifiable flow: preview-first import with skip-invalid behavior and confirm-then-save only.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-05-search-filter","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"In global search, does \"Account\" mean the sign-in identity account or the billable organization account?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Add an Account filter to global search.","T":"Add an Account filter that limits global search results by billable organization account.","S":"Apply the filter to global search across people and organizations using the billing meaning of account. Exclude filtering by authentication person Account and exclude broader search model changes.","V":"Verify that selecting an Account filter restricts results to entities associated with the chosen billable organization account and does not treat sign-in identity accounts as the filter domain.","X":"Stop if the current search index cannot associate both people and organizations to a billable organization account without additional data-model work.","P":"Persist with the narrowest truthful slice: a single filter definition tied to billing accounts only.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-02-notification-channel","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"For the first version, is an in-app notification sufficient when a build finishes, or do you need email or mobile push delivery?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Notify users when a build finishes.","T":"Create an in-app notification triggered by the existing build-completion internal event.","S":"Use the app's existing in-product notification system only. Exclude email, mobile push, and new notification providers.","V":"Verify that when a build reaches finished status, the internal event produces an in-app notification visible to the relevant user in the existing notification UI.","X":"Stop if build completion lacks enough user context to target the notification through the current in-product notification system.","P":"Persist with the smallest implementable channel already supported by the product: in-app notification only.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-01-login-audience","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"Who needs to log in, and do signed-in users need their data isolated from each other?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":false},{"question":"Should this use the existing identity provider if it can isolate users correctly, and otherwise stop rather than introducing a new provider?","scripted_answer_index":1,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Add login for multiple independent customers with data isolation.","T":"Add authentication using the existing provider only if it can support isolating independent customers from each other's data; otherwise stop without implementing.","S":"Cover sign-in/session integration at the existing session seam and validate whether the existing provider can enforce tenant isolation requirements. Exclude implementation of a new identity provider. Because no user, role, authorization, or record ownership model exists yet, this slice is limited to proving provider suitability and defining the minimum isolation boundary needed for truthful implementation.","V":"Verify whether the existing provider can represent separate customer identities and support isolating access between customers. If yes, confirm the required tenant/user ownership additions are identified as prerequisites; if no, stop with that finding.","X":"Stop if the existing provider cannot isolate independent customers, or if login cannot be made truthful without first introducing ownership and authorization data model changes.","P":"Persist on the smallest verifiable slice: assess and bind login to the current provider only under customer-isolation constraints; otherwise halt cleanly.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true},{"task_id":"ambiguous-04-team-invitations","route":"guided","turns":[{"question":"Should an invite create membership immediately, or must the invitee accept first, and if so should the invitation expire?","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"Add team invitations using the current membership service.","T":"Design and implement invitation-based membership where invitees accept before membership is created, with invitation links that expire after 7 days.","S":"Extend the current membership flow to support a pending invitation state, invitation issuance, acceptance, expiration after 7 days, and final creation of owner/member membership only upon acceptance. Exclude direct admin-created membership changes beyond coexistence with invitations.","V":"Verify that sending an invitation does not create membership immediately, that a valid invite link can be accepted to create the chosen role membership, and that expired links cannot create membership after 7 days.","X":"Stop if the current membership service cannot be extended with pending invitation state or tokenized acceptance without broader service redesign.","P":"Persist with the narrowest truthful addition: invitation acceptance and expiry layered onto the current membership service.","ready":true},"promotions":[],"stop_after_contract":true}]}
